standards.name: I can state the defining features of uniform samplers, use them to construct new samplers, and use them to check if a given sampler is valid.
I can create a sampler for a general one-dimensional probability distribution given its CDF or PDF.
I can use probabilistic concepts to qualitatively and quantitatively explain the sort of variability one should expect from a simulation's output.
I can apply the formal definition of confidence intervals to derive confidence interval procedures for both traditional and novel parameter estimation tasks.
I can apply confidence intervals in practical situations, handling concerns such as non-independence, multiple hypotheses, and multiple stages of study.
